text: こんな　やま　みちに　マニアが　いる　のよ…　みた？

structure.jp: こんな　やま　みちに
structure.en: on a mountain path like this

structure.jp: マニアが　いる　のよ…

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の here is the soft form of のだ, used when telling someone a fact they may not know; のよ sounds feminine. いる　のよ = 'there is one, you know'.
